item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 17/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The area of low pressure now over the northern part of the South China Sea and its associated showers will edge closer to the coast of western Guangdong and weaken gradually today. However, under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will still be showers over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will improve over southern China early next week.
